objectiveHistory: Get explicit human approval for the independent-verifier architecture before implementation begins

entries.commandOrAction: Approve the current v1 design and proceed to red tests
entries.expect: `architecture-approval` can be marked done and I can start `red-verifier-contract-tests` next
entries.notes: Fastest path if the current scope and tradeoffs look right

entries.expect: I update the mission docs first, revalidate, then continue
entries.notes: Best if you want to tighten the design before any tests are written

answers.prompt: Do you approve the proposed boundaries: `spawn_agent` owns verify inputs + worker→verifier orchestration, `spawned-agents.ts` owns reminders/reporting, prompt files own contract text, and `~/.mu/agent/AGENTS.md` owns durable policy?
Do you approve the v1 abstractions: optional `verify`, optional `verificationChecks`, mission `SPEC.md` discovery from `missionPath`, and a simple verification report of `PASS|FAIL` plus issues?
Do you approve the v1 tradeoffs: same model as worker by default, sequential verification, read-only verifier, and parent decides retry/accept/abort after the report?
Do you approve these priorities: verifier independence, correctness + spec adherence, parent control, prompt/policy/runtime consistency, and mission-level verifier gates?

notes: Recommended action: approve the v1 independent-verifier architecture so I can proceed to red tests. Why: the mission source of truth requires human approval before implementation, and the current proposal is already constrained to same-model, sequential worker→verifier flow with parent-controlled PASS/FAIL reporting.
